name: Dose Response Analysis Tool
description: A web application built with Plotly Dash that enables scientists to upload and visualize dose-response data, calculate pharmacological parameters, and generate publication-quality plots.
features: Calculate EC50, IC50, and other parameters

name: Assay Plate Layout Tool
description: A Next.js web application hosted on Vercel that allows researchers to design experimental layouts for multi-well plates, visualize sample distribution, and export layouts for automation.
features: Design experimental layouts for multi-well plates
Direct export to liquid handling robots

name: Echo Planner
description: A browser tool for planning, checking and exporting Beckman Echo acoustic dosing runs. You design the plate map, dose regimen, DMSO limits and randomization; a local LLM agent fills in only the compounds and their source wells from a LIMS export, so compound data never leaves your machine. The planner then handles the physical work: source well selection, intermediate dilution plates, droplet rounding, depletion checks and one Echo pick list per run stage.
features: Interactive 96/384/1536-well plate map editor with controls, edge exclusion and undo/redo
Exports a JSON Schema spec skeleton and agent prompt for a local LLM to fill compounds
Plans intermediate DMSO dilution tiers, droplet rounding, backfill and dead-volume depletion
Randomized layouts with edge mitigation, cross-plate decorrelation and diagnostics
Generates Echo pick lists per run stage plus a manual-additions bench checklist
